records.label: Example
records.quote: ABC is a right angled triangle at C, A B = 13 cm, B C = 12 cm
records.stem: ABC is a right angled triangle at C, AB = 13 cm, BC = 12 cm. A: Find the length AC. B: Find each of the following: sin A, cos A, tan A, sin B, cos B, tan B. C: Prove that: sin A cos B + cos A sin B = 1. D: Find: 1 + tan² A.

parts.label: A
solution: Since ABC is a right angled triangle at C, therefore $(AC)^2=(AB)^2-(BC)^2$

parts.label: B
parts.stem: Find each of the following: sin A, cos A, tan A, sin B, cos B, tan B

parts.label: C
parts.stem: Prove that: sin A cos B + cos A sin B = 1
solution: The right side = $\sin A\cos B+\cos A\sin B$

records.notes: Triangle figure k3 belongs to this example.

objectives.label: Compare sides and ratios in a right triangle
objectives.description: Compare side lengths and ratios of sides in a right-angled triangle, using the hypotenuse and the Pythagorean relation.

objectives.label: Convert between degrees-minutes-seconds and decimal degrees
objectives.description: Write angles given in degrees, minutes and seconds as decimal degrees, and decimal degrees as degrees, minutes and seconds, by hand or with a calculator.

objectives.label: Name the sides and define sin, cos and tan
objectives.description: Identify the opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse sides for an acute angle and state sine, cosine and tangent as ratios of those sides.

objectives.label: Find and use the trigonometric ratios of acute angles
objectives.description: Find the missing side, then the six ratios of the acute angles in a right triangle, and use them to prove simple identities.
